title: Searching a chest for traps
description: A successful perception check finds no trap. The narration should follow the engine outcome and name the chest; the summary must keep its roll line.
player_input: I search the chest for traps, then open it.

play.consequence_planner.mechanical_summary: Lyra searches the chest for traps (d20 rolled 14 + 3 = 17 vs DC 12 -> success). No trap is found.

scripted.play.narrator: You run your fingers along the chest's hinges and find no wire and no needle. The lid lifts with a soft creak, and inside lies a folded cloak. Where do you go next?
